'''February 2005 Franklin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held on 19 February 2005 at Outer Limits in Franklin, Tennessee.<ref name="pcf-2860-61606">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=61606#61606 Tennessee tournaments], Royce Russell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2860-62368">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=62368#62368 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (11 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Ten players took part, and [[Danny Pack]] won.<ref name="pcf-2860-63487">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=63487#63487 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (22 February 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Outer Limits, Franklin, Tennessee<ref name="pcf-2860-62368" />
* '''Dates:''' 19 February 2005, 12 noon<ref name="pcf-2860-61606" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $3, with prize support<ref name="pcf-2860-62368" />
* '''Players:''' 10<ref name="pcf-2860-63487" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Danny Pack]]<ref name="pcf-2860-63487" />

The tournament was one of the monthly Star Wars CCG tournaments at Outer Limits, held on the third Saturday of the month,<ref name="pcf-2860-54919">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=54919#54919 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (6 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> which [[Micah Wooten]] ran.<ref name="pcf-2860-57864">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=57864#57864 Tennessee tournaments], Micah Wooten, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 December 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050224204034/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=58049%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> [[Royce Russell]] posted the date and the tournament's listing on Decipher's tournament site,<ref name="pcf-2860-61606" /> and Wooten announced the entry fee.<ref name="pcf-2860-62368" /> Pack won the tournament foil. The next tournament was set for 19 March 2005.<ref name="pcf-2860-63487" />
